results.title: Reality Star Billi Mucklow Breaks Stereotypes as 'Perfect' Stepmother
results.description: Reality star Billi Mucklow has formed a close bond with her two stepchildren, Emilie Rose and Lucas, defying the stereotype of a stepmother. Despite the turbulent end of her relationship with ex footballer Andy Carroll, her bond with the children remains strong.

results.title: Mamdani reveals the secret to his chummy relationship with Trump during ‘Jimmy Kimmel Live!’ NYC broadcast
results.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani shared how he and President Trump bond over their love for the city and Sunnyside Yards.

results.title: Pyo Ye-jin goes on Twinkle Twinkle shopping spree in Singapore: 'Why are there so many?'
results.description: South Korean actress Pyo Ye-jin appears to have caught the Pop Mart bug during her recent trip to Singapore.The 34-year-old shared an Instagram post on Sept 26, showing what she described as a "Twinkle Twinkle hunting" expedition through a 20-photo carousel of her blind box pulls. Adding to the theme, Ye-jin also used TaeTiSeo's Twinkle (2012) as the post's background...
